description: Discounted boats (one row per boat and week) filtered by destination, departure month or date window, boat type, cabins, group size (berths), minimum discount and maximum whole-boat price. Sorted by discount, whole-boat price or price per berth. With any filter beyond destination/month/type/cabins every matching boat is considered, `matching` says how many there are and `next_offset` pages through them. Without a month or date window each boat appears once (its best week). Returns dates, whole-boat price, list price, discount, per-berth price, photo, source, when the price was checked and the boat page.

departure_from.description: Earliest departure date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. a flexible week: 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-15)

max_price_eur.description: Maximum whole-boat price for the week, EUR

min_discount_pct.description: Only boats at least this much off the list price, %

month.description: Departure month, YYYY-MM (the next three months are covered)

offset.description: Skip this many results: pass next_offset from the previous call

people.description: People sleeping aboard: only boats with at least this many berths

sort.description: discount — biggest first; price — cheapest whole boat; per_berth — cheapest per berth (best for a full boat)

name: search_deals
title: Search discounted yachts
